# worked-example

Built from the brief's worked example (fb-scrap-engine/docs/design/PARTS_INTELLIGENCE.md:74-79):
a 9800X3D + RTX 5080 PC among 12 comparable PC asks sits at about the 29th percentile, and the
"Used - like new" subset of 6 asks is hidden. The actor repository is not in this session, so the
asks are synthetic: twelve used-good PCs at £1,500 to £2,050 in £50 steps, the target the fourth
lowest (£1,650): rank 4, (3 + 0.5) / 12 = 29.2%. Six like-new PCs at £1,700 to £1,950 form their own
groups (asking-price-index keys by condition), n = 6: positions are recorded (T4) but not shown.

The brief's "any condition" group has no counterpart: asking-price-index groups by condition
(docs/questions/asking-price-position.md). Each PC is positioned in its CPU and its GPU group, so
the 12 used-good PCs give 24 shown rows and the 6 like-new ones 12 hidden rows.
